subject: history
concept: Understanding why governments exist and what basic services they provide
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts service cards (roads, schools, fire department) into 'government-provided' and 'not government-provided' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a government service to the need it meets
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a described service is usually provided by government rather than individuals alone

misconception_flags: cannot explain why a shared service benefits from being organized at a community/government level

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
